title: Epilepsy DL Review (50 papers) → Project Gap Analysis

gaps.why: Seizure Prediction Dashboard — wearable biomarker analysis, risk thresholds, pre-ictal biomarker comparison, patient-level performance (3 endpoints verified 200)

Time-Frequency Representations Dashboard — 6 TFR methods (STFT, CWT, DWT, Spectrogram, Mel-Spectrogram, WVD/SPWVD), 6 EEG frequency bands, 6-stage pipeline (raw EEG → TFR → model input), resolution matrix, use-case map, glossary, references. 3 endpoints (/api/time-frequency/overview|breakdown|definitions verified 200) + portal-next /time-frequency page + nav wired. Built 2026-08-06.

Closed-Loop Neurostimulation Dashboard — 3 endpoints (/api/closed-loop/*) + ClosedLoopDashboard.jsx with 5-tab frontend: pre-ictal detection → alert trigger → responder notification → response → outcome audit. Real data from wearable_readings, seizure_diary, emergency_sos_events, iot_alerts.
Project ships RandomForest only; review's SOTA is deep models

GNN Electrode Connectivity Dashboard — 10-20 montage graph analysis, node features, edge weights (coherence/PLV/MI/Granger), regional connectivity, seizure propagation patterns, ST-GCN architecture (3 endpoints verified 200)
SNN Neuromorphic Dashboard — LIF neuron simulation, spike pattern analysis, STDP learning, power comparison (SNN vs CNN/LSTM/Transformer), 3 endpoints + 5-tab frontend

Transfer Learning Dashboard — 3 endpoints (/api/transfer-learning/*) + TransferLearningDashboard.jsx with 4 strategies (subject-independent, fine-tune, DANN, multi-task), per-patient adaptation metrics, domain shift analysis

Federated Learning Dashboard — 3 endpoints (/api/federated-learning/*) + FederatedLearningDashboard.jsx with multi-site analytics, FedAvg/FedProx/FedMA comparison, differential privacy tracking, convergence curves, gradient analysis
Bonn external validation built — Benchmark Validation Dashboard (3 endpoints /api/benchmark-validation/* + BenchmarkValidationDashboard.jsx 5-tab frontend). TUH/TUSZ cataloged.
Addresses class imbalance (rare ictal) — review highlights

Neonatal EEG Dashboard — Helsinki dataset (79 neonates, 22-ch, 256 Hz). 3 endpoints (/api/neonatal-eeg/*) + NeonatalEEGDashboard.jsx with 5-tab frontend: overview (KPIs, GA distribution, adult vs neonate radar), patterns (background characteristics, classification, GA profiles, montage comparison, aEEG), seizures (types + etiology), performance (detection comparison, gap analysis), definitions. Real published data from Stevenson et al. 2019.

Cross-Patient Benchmark Dashboard — 3 endpoints (/api/cross-patient-benchmark/*) + CrossPatientDashboard.jsx with LOSO fold analysis, generalization gap (0.705 vs 0.99), feature importance, spatial patterns, 5-tab frontend. Real CHB-MIT data (chb02/03/04).

gaps.feature: Foundation model pretraining (self-supervised on unlabeled EEG)
gaps.why: Foundation Models Dashboard — 206 models, 9 architectures, 7 diseases, production+experimental tiers, 3 endpoints verified 200
Forecasting needs FAR/hr + sensitivity@horizon, not just accuracy
Hybrid Pipeline Dashboard — CNN-LSTM vs CNN-Transformer architecture comparison, layer analysis, attention weights, LSTM gates, training curves (3 endpoints verified 200)
Edge Deployment Dashboard — ONNX export pipeline, quantization modes (FP16/INT8/INT4), 6 device targets, model compatibility matrix, 5-tab frontend (3 endpoints verified 200)

gaps.feature: Seizure-risk forecasting decision layer (alert thresholds + escalation)
gaps.why: Dashboard with 4-tier risk scoring (low/moderate/high/critical), 5 forecast horizons, threshold config, per-patient forecasts, escalation log, and gap analysis

gaps.feature: Closed-loop decision (pre-ictal → caregiver/stim action) with audit
gaps.why: Closed-Loop Neurostimulation Dashboard — per-patient closed-loop audit with trigger method → outcome effectiveness, event timeline, IoT alert audit, response latency by event type. Governed action records via emergency_sos_events with outcome classification.

top_recommendations: Add a deep-learning model (EEGNet/1D-CNN) trained on CHB-MIT with subject-wise split — closes the #1 technology gap and gives a defensible deep-model baseline.
Add spectrogram (STFT/wavelet) representation + 2D-CNN — unlocks the review's main input modality.
Add seizure FORECASTING (pre-ictal classification) with FAR/hr + sensitivity@horizon metrics — moves from detection to prediction (novel for DBA).
Run cross-patient (leave-subjects-out) benchmark on full CHB-MIT — the honest generalization number.
Add TUSZ/Bonn dataset loaders — standard benchmarks reviewers expect.
